meta.name: ai-search-visibility-audit
meta.description: Audit whether a website can be found, crawled, and cited by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Microsoft Copilot. Use when someone asks why their brand is missing from AI answers, whether AI crawlers can read their site, how to get cited by ChatGPT or Perplexity, or asks for a GEO or AEO (generative / answer engine optimization) review. Produces a citation baseline across buyer-intent prompts, a crawler-access check, a citability review of named pages, and a ranked fix list. Not for keyword rank tracking, paid search, or pages behind a login.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI搜索引用情况并生成优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想提升品牌在AI答案引擎中的被引用率
copy.tagline_en: See why your brand is missing from AI answers and get fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your brand cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, or AI Overviews

howto.what: Claude 会按四个阶段审计网站：用买家意图提示词建立引用基线，检查 robots.txt 和爬虫可达性，评估页面内容是否易被引用，分析引用来源；最后输出含结论、阻塞项、修复清单和局限性的报告。
howto.when: 当用户询问 AI 可见性问题（如品牌缺席 AI 回答、AI 爬虫能否读取、如何被引用）或要求做 GEO/AEO 审查时触发。

say.text: 为什么我们品牌没出现在 ChatGPT 的回答里？
say.note: 开始建立引用基线并检查阻塞项。

say.text: 检查我们网站的 robots.txt 是否屏蔽了 AI 爬虫。
say.note: 执行爬虫可达性检查，找出阻断引用的配置。

say.text: 我们品牌在 Perplexity 里被描述错了，怎么办？
say.note: 定位第三方错误描述并给出修改建议。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a four-phase audit: build a citation baseline with buyer-intent prompts, check robots.txt and crawler reachability, evaluate content citability, and analyze citation sources. It then outputs a report with verdict, blockers, fix list, and limitations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks why a brand is missing from AI answers, whether AI crawlers can read a site, or how to get cited by AI engines, or requests a GEO/AEO review.

say_en.text: Why isn't our brand showing up in ChatGPT's answers?
say_en.note: Starts the citation baseline and blocker checks.

say_en.text: Check if our robots.txt is blocking AI crawlers.
say_en.note: Runs the crawler-access check to find blocking rules.

say_en.text: Our brand is described wrong on Perplexity. What do we do?
say_en.note: Finds the inaccurate third-party mention and suggests a fix.
